t: The largest Channel Island, it stayed with the English crown when King John lost Normandy to France in 1204.
It keeps Norman customary law, its Royal Court and its own parliament, the States, as a Crown Dependency outside the UK.
Once a fortified frontier against France, it became a cod-trading, farming and later financial centre.
dyk: New Jersey is named after the island: in 1664 the Duke of York granted the land to Sir George Carteret, a Jerseyman who had held the island for the Stuarts.
ev: King John loses Normandy, but Jersey stays with the English crown
The French take Mont Orgueil and hold Jersey until 1468
Pope Sixtus IV grants the Channel Islands neutrality in wartime
Charles II is proclaimed king in Saint Helier
A French invasion is defeated at the Battle of Jersey
Ministerial government with a Chief Minister is introduced
